lines.say: The study police have made an arrest.
Suspect: the notes app. Face the camera.
Count one: holds every lecture, never tells you to open one.
Count two: two hundred notes, all called untitled.
Count three: organising notes, disguised as studying.
Offload turns your notes into a plan, one block at a time, and moves it when you miss a day.
It tests you on them, so they stick.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
